label: Bible Study
prompt: And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall _____, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.
verse: And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.
note: One of the clearest Old Testament glimpses of resurrection — sleepers in the dust waking up.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Grace to you, and _____, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verse: Grace to you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
note: Paul's short personal letter to his friend Philemon opens the way so many of his letters do: grace and peace.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Howbeit the hair of his head began to _____ again after he was shaven.
verse: Howbeit the hair of his head began to grow again after he was shaven.
note: One quiet verse of hope: in the prison house, Samson's hair began to grow again.

label: Deep Water
prompt: In the midst of the street of it, and on either side of the river, was there the tree of life, which bare twelve manner of fruits, and yielded her fruit every month: and the _____ of the tree were for the healing of the nations.
verse: In the midst of the street of it, and on either side of the river, was there the tree of life, which bare twelve manner of fruits, and yielded her fruit every month: and the leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations.
note: The tree of life, barred in Genesis 3, stands on both riverbanks — with leaves for the healing of nations.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: To speak evil of no man, to be no _____, but gentle, shewing all meekness unto all men.
verse: To speak evil of no man, to be no brawlers, but gentle, shewing all meekness unto all men.
note: Speak evil of no man, be no 'brawlers' — Paul's civility code for the believers on Crete.
